subject: planner, statistics: async load should load all column meta info for lite init (#53297)
summary: This commit extends async stats loading to support per-item load intent (full vs meta-only) by storing a boolean alongside each needed TableItemID and returning it as model.StatsLoadItem. Planner-side DataSource stats init now registers all public columns that are missing in-memory meta (lite init / missing meta) for async loading with FullLoad=false, while existing call sites that truly need histograms (planner usage collection, ColumnStatsIsInvalid, IndexStatsIsInvalid) request FullLoad=true. The async loader path (LoadNeededHistograms) is updated so columns can be loaded either as full (histogram buckets + CMSketch/TopN/FMSketch) or as meta-only (stats_histograms only, marking stats as AllEvicted), while indexes remain full-load. The lite-init handle test is adjusted to assert that non-predicate columns become AllEvicted after async loading, indicating meta is present without fully loading stats.
